During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a two-[[Gender/Legends|man]] '''Rebel cell''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]. Its two members were both [[Spy/Legends|spies]]; the wealthy gentlemen of leisure [[Seth Cambriel]], and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] worker [[Harbold Taft]].
